world.interventions: Vibrato task commands only; no give, teleport, game-mode, time or weather commands.

fresh_boundary_world.name: human-polish-boundary-20261027
fresh_boundary_world.result: completed using a crafted wooden axe

completed_live_checks: Reproduced torch crafting waiting indefinitely on the recipe book in the old build.
Rebuilt client crafted eight torches from the same naturally gathered coal and sticks.
@play builder started a populated plan after torch completion; lasting 0/0 was not reproduced.
Reproduced and fixed parent gathering reclaiming ingredients from a prerequisite crafting grid.
Obtained an axe and completed the 24-oak-log request using it; climbed out of a mining shaft en route.
The later fresh-world 16-log request also completed after crafting an axe from an empty inventory.
Obtained a shovel and completed a 20-dirt request using it.
Observed a focused spider encounter with jump attacks followed by return to gathering.
Autonomous play smelted iron, crafted a bucket and successfully milked a cow.
Observed sprinting on eligible ascents, ordinary descents, pillaring and long coordinate travel.
Urgent autonomous foraging activated from an injured, hungry save; that test ended in a skeleton-shot death.
fixes_after_observed_failures: Passive interaction targets no longer suppress danger escape; disabled guard-range sentinels are respected.
Vulnerable bots retreat from visible skeletons; ranged escape goals include skeletons.
Autonomous forage budgets stop after recovery or player replacement on respawn.
Prepare all missing milk buckets together instead of repeating iron-to-cow round trips.
Water route costs now use the actual 0-to-1 movement efficiency attribute; unenchanted water costs more than dry ground.
Dropped-item pursuit retains a valid target; airborne landing view no longer follows tiny reversed correction vectors.
Opportunistic resource pickups reject distant/deep detours such as a torch beneath the seabed; ordinary acquisition remains available.
Manual crafting accepts excess correct ingredients and splits donor inputs only when needed, with an empty cursor.
other_changes: Safe path lookahead, calculation glances and optional clear-corridor sprint jumps preserve precise planner movement.
Bounded search opportunities carry across navigation legs and can harvest berries, limited seeds or reachable ore.
Activity-area shares no longer scale with registry size; activity novelty and draft-plan diversity retain persona bias.
The shear_sheep activity obtains shears and shears adults instead of using a kill-for-wool alias.
Smelting, smithing and partially failed resource startup release their behavior scopes.
Smaller crafting/fuel transfers can take half stacks, and source selection prefers the smallest sufficient stack.
limits: Natural survival is not failure-free: one recorded low-health foraging run died to a skeleton before the ranged escape fix.
A separate diagnostic reload drowned while no task was active: its launch helper sent chat before world entry accepted it. This was an idle test-control failure, not an autonomous recovery result.
New shearing, optional flat-ground jump eligibility and opportunistic-search bounds have regression tests; not every case was exercised live.
Inventory packet-type coverage does not establish click-action-mode coverage. Recorded gameplay modes are listed per session.
The source-remapping task emits a source-jar warning; the playable jar, compilation and both test suites succeed.
The modified engine remains in the independent /opt/Baritone checkout. Its exact working diff and added source files are in the evidence archive.

shore_route.note: Idle diagnostic launch lost one health point before the active shore route began; route reached dry ground and full health.

distant_torch_pickup_regression.before: Torch request pursued an item at y=32 from surface terrain near y=68.
distant_torch_pickup_regression.after: Same world request pursued coal/tool/stick prerequisites and the four-torch craft completed; no pursuit of the deep torch.
